newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak blue chips open week mixed in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Slovak blue chips open week mixed in listless trade.

text.p: Leading Slovak shares opened the week mixed in listless trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Monday, as the SAX index firmed 0.13 points to 203.12.
Oil refiner Slovnaft closed up two crowns 912, while VSZ closed down one crown at 639, with brokers saying the stell maker's shares should hover around current levels.
"VSZ price's should not move significantly in either way in the near future, and the possible changes would probably be only technical corrections," said Libor Briska of Creditanstalt.
Oil and gas storage Nafta and VUB bank did not trade on Monday.
Brokers said unlisted medium-sized companies Vahostav and Drotovna were the only shares to trade in interesting volumes during the floor session.
Builder Vahostav traded 15,420 shares and closed up 40 crowns at 1,940, while Drotovna, a producer of construction steel products, gained 30 crowns at 940 with traded 17,000 shares.
Overall volume rose to 561,755 shares, boosted mainly by direct trades, from 542,206 shares traded on Friday. Turnover increased to 561.84 million crowns, from 306.48 million on Friday.
